title: TapEvent
description: One event emitted by DBLog's educational observability tap over GET /api/v1/tap/stream. Off by default and never for production use. This file is the union of the per-kind schemas under events/ — Rust/TypeScript consumers point their codegen (typify, quicktype, etc.) here. The Java POJOs are generated from the per-kind files under events/, not from this union.
